tok=re.search(r'name="id_token" value="([^"]+)"',html).group(1)
open('token_strata.jwt','w').write(tok)
h,p,s=tok.split('.')
def d(x): return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(x+'='*(-len(x)%4)))
print("HEADER",json.dumps(d(h),indent=1))
print("PAYLOAD",json.dumps(d(p),indent=1))
open('cert_strata.der','wb').write(base64.b64decode(d(h)['x5c'][0]))
EOF
openssl x509 -inform DER -in cert_strata.der -noout -text | head -40"}
